title: Professional staffing family — pair dispositions (four buckets)
scope: Candidate universe: all R4xx/R6xx/R7xx (professional/administrative/management support) pairs, any award-NAICS. PSC decides the bucket where specific (R425 → engineering; R408/R497/R7xx → program-management; R6xx → administrative); NAICS breaks the tie on generic R4xx codes (5413/5417 → engineering; else → program-management); all R-support under 5415x → Federal IT Staffing. OUT: pairs already homed to existing collections; industry NAICS (construction/manufacturing/healthcare) where R-support is incidental; facilities-services NAICS outside employment services.
